bias.en: Bearish · reclaimed $316, testing the October lows
bias.zh: 看空 · 收复 $316，测试 10 月低点

read.en: Broadcom rose 8.8% on Nov 9 to $319.48, trading $304.29–323.05 on volume 1.5 times its 20-day average. It closed above the falling 5-day ($312.46) but below the falling 10-day ($324.98), 30-day ($340.12), 100-day ($366.50) and 200-day ($367.09). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($343.98), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: 博通 11月9日上涨 8.8%，收于 $319.48，盘中区间 $304.29–323.05，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.5 倍。收盘站上下行的 5 日均线（$312.46），但仍位于下行的 10 日（$324.98）、30 日（$340.12）、100 日（$366.50）和 200 日均线（$367.09）下方。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$343.98），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The rally cleared the $300 and $311.5–316.3 resistances (Nov 5–6 highs, 5-day, Feb 17 low), now support, and reached the $319.3–321.9 October lows. Resistance is $319.3–323.1 (Oct 22–23 and Oct 30 lows, Nov 9 high), then $325–326.6 (10-day, Nov 3 low) and $340.1–344 (30-day, SAR). Support is $311.5–316.3, then $304.3 and $300. A close above $323.1 would target $325–327; below $311.5, $304.

s.en: Nov 6 high $311.5; 5-day average $312.5; Nov 5 high $314.0; Feb 17 low $316.3
